changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tenant_b2c_config ( id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, tenant_id BIGINT NOT NULL, enabled TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 1, b2c_tenant_name VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, b2c_tenant_id VARCHAR(256), client_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, client_secret TEXT NOT NULL, signup_signin_policy VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, logout_policy VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, redirect_uri VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL, post_logout_redirect_uri VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL, scope VARCHAR(512) DEFAULT 'openid profile email offline_access', created_by VARCHAR(255), created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, modified_by VARCHAR(255), modified_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CONSTRAINT fk_tenant_b2c_tenant FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id) REFERENCES tenant(tenant_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT uk_tenant_b2c_config UNIQUE (tenant_id) ); CREATE INDEX idx_tenant_b2c_tenant_id ON tenant_b2c_config(tenant_id);

changeSet.author: facilon
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tenant_graph_email_config ( id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, tenant_id BIGINT NOT NULL, enabled TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 1, tenant_id_azure VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, client_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, client_secret TEXT NOT NULL, sender_email VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, sender_name VARCHAR(256) DEFAULT 'Facilon Platform', max_retries INT DEFAULT 3, retry_delay_ms BIGINT DEFAULT 1000, connection_timeout INT DEFAULT 30000, read_timeout INT DEFAULT 30000, debug_mode TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 0, created_by VARCHAR(255), created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, modified_by VARCHAR(255), modified_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CONSTRAINT fk_tenant_graph_email_tenant FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id) REFERENCES tenant(tenant_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT uk_tenant_graph_email_config UNIQUE (tenant_id) ); CREATE INDEX idx_tenant_graph_email_tenant_id ON tenant_graph_email_config(tenant_id);

changeSet.author: facilon
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tenant_sharepoint_config ( id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, tenant_id BIGINT NOT NULL, enabled TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 0, site_hostname VARCHAR(512), site_path VARCHAR(512) DEFAULT '/sites/FacilonInvestor', document_library VARCHAR(256), tenant_id_azure VARCHAR(256), client_id VARCHAR(256), client_secret TEXT, created_by VARCHAR(255), created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, modified_by VARCHAR(255), modified_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CONSTRAINT fk_tenant_sharepoint_tenant FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id) REFERENCES tenant(tenant_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT uk_tenant_sharepoint_config UNIQUE (tenant_id) ); CREATE INDEX idx_tenant_sharepoint_tenant_id ON tenant_sharepoint_config(tenant_id);
